messages.În timpul Δt în care punctul B_{1} al fr: During the interval Δt, point B_{1} on the wavefront reaches B′. In that time, the wavelet from A′ travels at the same speed v_{1} and covers the distance A′A_{1} = B_{1}B′ = v_{1}Δt.
messages.Punctele de pe suprafață dintre A′ și B′: Points along the boundary between A′ and B′ become successive sources of wavelets. The tangent B′A_{1} to these wavelets is the reflected wavefront.
messages.Din triunghiurile dreptunghice formate d: The right triangles formed by the wavefronts give B_{1}B′ = A′B′·sin i and A′A_{1} = A′B′·sin r. Since the distances are equal, sin i = sin r, so i = r.
messages.Păstrăm aceeași geometrie, dar urmărim u: Keep the same geometry, but follow the wavelets travelling through medium 2 at speed v_{2}. First assume v_{2} < v_{1}: during the same interval Δt, the wavelet from A′ travels a shorter distance than the incident wavefront.
messages.În timpul Δt, frontul incident avansează: During Δt, the incident wavefront advances by B_{1}B′ = v_{1}Δt, while the wavelet from A′ advances by A′A_{2} = v_{2}Δt.
messages.Tangenta B′A_{2} la undele elementare di: The tangent B′A_{2} to the wavelets in medium 2 is the refracted wavefront. The angle between the refracted ray and the normal is the angle of refraction r.
messages.Din triunghiurile dreptunghice: B_{1}B′: The right triangles give B_{1}B′ = A′B′·sin i and A′A_{2} = A′B′·sin r. Dividing the equations gives the law of refraction.
messages.03Dacă v_{2} < v_{1}, atunci r < i: raza: If v_{2} < v_{1}, then r < i: the refracted ray bends toward the normal. If v_{2} > v_{1}, then r > i: the ray bends away from the normal.
messages.Când unda trece dintr-un mediu cu viteză: When a wave passes from a slower medium into a faster one (v_{2} > v_{1}), the angle of refraction increases faster than the angle of incidence. At the critical angle i_{c}, the refracted ray becomes tangent to the boundary (r = 90°). Beyond it, the wave no longer enters medium 2 and is reflected entirely:
messages.Schimbă vitezele celor două medii și ung: Change the speeds in the two media and the angle of incidence. When v_{2} > v_{1} and the angle exceeds the critical angle, the refracted ray disappears — a sign of total reflection.

messages.Atunci sin r = 1, iar legea refracției d: Then sin r = 1, and the law of refraction becomes sin i_{c} = v_{1}/v_{2}.
messages.În același Δt, raza undei elementare est: During the same Δt, the wavelet radius is v_{2}Δt > v_{1}Δt, so the tangent makes a larger angle with the boundary.
messages.Din aceleași triunghiuri dreptunghice, s: The same right triangles give sin i/sin r = v_{1}/v_{2} < 1, so r > i: the refracted ray bends away from the normal.
messages.Raza refractată se apropie de suprafață: The refracted ray approaches the boundary and becomes tangent to it at i = i_{c}, where sin i_{c} = v_{1}/v_{2}. For i > i_{c}, the wave no longer passes through: total reflection occurs.
messages.Pentru v_{2} < v_{1}, raza se apropie de: For v_{2} < v_{1}, the ray bends toward the normal, and total reflection cannot occur as the wave enters medium 2.
